source.datasheet_title: HX6537-A WE-I Plus ASIC Data Sheet

notes: total_sram_bytes (2112 KB) sums the datasheet's own itemized Features list: 320 kB program ICCM local memory + 320 kB data DCCM/XCCM/YCCM local memory + 1472 kB system memory. The datasheet's own intro paragraph rounds this to 'internal 2 MB' -- the itemized sum (2112 KB, slightly over 2 MiB) is used here instead, same convention as this project applies elsewhere when a headline figure and an itemized breakdown disagree. total_flash_bytes is deliberately null: flash is 'SIP 1MB/2MB Flash (LQFP/QFN packages only)' per the same Features list -- a package-dependent System-in-Package option, not a single chip-level constant, so no single figure would be honest here; pick a specific package/part suffix before shipping one number. dev_kit_aliases: Seeed's Grove Vision AI Module V1 is HX6537-A-based -- do not conflate with V2, which uses a different chip (HX6538). Document is marked 'Preliminary' on its cover; the chip has shipped in production boards for years, but this is noted for honesty rather than silently treated as final. Fetched directly via a SparkFun-hosted mirror, not blocked; 30 pp., read in full.
